## Accepted-OOS Disposition (Step 9a.1)

- FINDING_8: Decompose harness uses older pairing pattern — folded inline (test-decompose-panel-dispatch.sh)

## Rejected / Out-of-Scope Observations (not filed)

### OOS_FINDING_10
- **OOS_FINDING_10**: Empty-merge branch does not validate attestation line content — exonerated (3 EXON). Plan explicitly accepted this edge case; no filing needed.

### OOS_FINDING_11
- **OOS_FINDING_11**: REVIEW_CORE_*_SH override surface — exonerated (2 EXON, 1 NO). Pre-existing trust-boundary; out of scope for this PR.

### OOS_FINDING_12
- **OOS_FINDING_12**: Aggregator-disabled mode still dispatches voters with MERGED_COUNT=0 — exonerated (2 EXON, 1 NO). Unchanged by this branch.
